**Download**

- `Glance.exe` (~0.5 MB) needs the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0)
- `Glance-standalone.exe` (~70 MB) runs anywhere on Windows 11, with no runtime needed

Put it in its own folder and add a `client.json` ([setup guide](https://github.com/BosTheCoder/glance/blob/main/docs/google-setup.md)), then run it. To try it without Google, run `Glance.exe --demo`.
